description: Idle soak, 10 minutes at the default 60s DOM interval. Resource footprint rather than latency.
metric: RSS, CPU%, thread count, fd count
excludes: rss_language_claim: the Rust binary embeds CPython (pyo3 auto-initialize) and imports sonic_platform_base, so expect RSS in the same order as Python, not 10x lower. Report the delta, do not frame it as a language win.
noop_floor: subtract the inject-noop baseline (pmon + emulator + everything that is not xcvrd) before reporting any resource number.
notes: Implemented in the DUT harness (benchmark/dut/xbench.py): ./tools/run_dut_bench.sh B5 --variants rust,python
